tools.name: flynode_whoami
tools.description: Show which FlyNode account and token this is, and what the token may do.

tools.name: flynode_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Cloud Workspaces (plans) the account has, with how many apps each holds.

tools.name: flynode_list_apps
tools.description: List the apps in the account: id, name, status, address, project key.

tools.name: flynode_ship
tools.description: Deploy a project from a Git repository to FlyNode in one call: creates the app (or updates the one with the same name), sets variables and databases, builds, waits until it is live or failed, then checks the address. Push the code to the Git remote first. If it fails, read "hints" and "logTail", fix the project, push, and call again (at most 3 attempts). Variable VALUES passed in env are sent to FlyNode but never echoed back. To send a .env file without it appearing in the conversation use flynode_set_env_from_file.

name.description: App name. Defaults to the one in .flynode.json.

repoUrl.description: Public Git repository URL (https). For private repositories use gitKeyId + gitRepoAddress.

gitKeyId.description: Deploy key id for a private repository.

gitRepoAddress.description: git@host:owner/repo.git address the deploy key was made for.

branch.description: Branch. Leave out for the repository default.

env.description: Non-secret variables only, such as NODE_ENV. Use flynode_set_env_from_file for secrets.

databases.description: Databases the app needs. FlyNode creates them and wires their connection variables.

port.description: Port the app listens on, if not auto-detected.

baseDirectory.description: Sub-folder of the repository to build (monorepos).

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the build in this call (default 50 locally, 20 on the hosted server; clients often time out a call at 60 s). If it is still building, call flynode_status or flynode_wait.

tools.name: flynode_wait
tools.description: Wait for a build to finish (up to ~50 s per call; call again while it says building). Returns status, address and the end of the build log.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_status
tools.description: Status of one app: state, address, recent deploys, and an HTTP check of the address.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_logs
tools.description: Read logs. kind "build" is the newest (or given) build log; "runtime" is the live container output.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_redeploy
tools.description: Rebuild and restart an app from its current branch (use after pushing new commits if auto-deploy is off).

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_rollback
tools.description: Put an earlier deploy back (reversible). Get commits from flynode_status recentDeploys.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_list_env
tools.description: Names of the app variables. Values are never returned.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_set_env_from_file
tools.description: Send the variables from a LOCAL .env-style file (inside the project folder) to the app. The values go straight from disk to FlyNode and never appear in this conversation. Only names are reported back.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

file.description: Path of the .env file, relative to the project folder.

tools.name: flynode_add_database
tools.description: Add a database to an app and wire its connection variables. The password is never shown.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_add_domain
tools.description: Attach a custom domain. The user must point DNS at FlyNode (CNAME/A) as FlyNode instructs.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_delete_app
tools.description: PERMANENTLY delete an app and its data. Needs a token with the destroy scope. confirm must be the exact app name typed by the USER; never fill it in on your own. Ask the user first.

app.description: App id, project key or exact app name (see flynode_list_apps).

tools.name: flynode_wp_deploy_site
tools.description: Deploy a WHOLE local WordPress site (database + wp-content) to a NEW FlyNode WordPress site: packs it on this computer, uploads it, and FlyNode loads it into a fresh site and points it at its own address. Nothing existing is changed. Needs wp-cli on the PATH, or pass sqlFile (a .sql or .sql.gz export of the database). Up to 2 GB; use skipUploads for a big media library. After this returns call flynode_wp_import_status until it is ok.

dir.description: The WordPress folder that contains wp-content (in LocalWP: the "app/public" folder).

name.description: Name of the new FlyNode site.

sqlFile.description: Path of a database export (.sql or .sql.gz) when wp-cli is not available.

workspaceId.description: Needed only when the account has more than one Workspace.

tools.name: flynode_wp_import_status
tools.description: Follow a WordPress site upload started with flynode_wp_deploy_site. Waits up to waitSeconds for a change. When status is ok the new site address is returned.
